ANGLE MECHANIC

ACUTE & OBTUSE ANGLES WORKSHOP

REPAIR THE MACHINES. BUILD THE RIGHT ANGLES.

📐 ACUTE ANGLE Greater than 0° • Less than 90° Sharp & narrow angle
📐 OBTUSE ANGLE Greater than 90° • Less than 180° Wide & opened angle
STUCENT EDITION • ROOM: ACUTE AND OBTUSE

HOW TO PLAY

1

READ THE MISSION

Check the banner to see what angle the broken machine needs: ACUTE (< 90°) or OBTUSE (> 90°).

2

PHYSICALLY ROTATE THE PART

Drag the machine arm with your mouse/touch, or use A / D / Arrow keys to set the exact angle.

3

LOCK & REPAIR

Press SPACE or click LOCK ANGLE. If correct, the machine activates, gears spin, and you earn points!

4

COMPLETE ALL 10 ROUNDS

Face moving arms, narrow precision targets, and multi-machine combos to become the MASTER MECHANIC!

ACUTE (< 90°) 📐 45° Pointy / Small
RIGHT (90°) ∟ 90° Square Corner
OBTUSE (> 90°) ⊿ 135° Wide / Open
